messages:
alex: Heads-up: modelrouter v12.0.0 canary (2%) in ap-east showing sustained queue backpressure and higher p99. Recommend pause on percent increases.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started: modelrouter v12.0.0 -> 2% ap-east at 3524689987. Health: degraded, errors: 0.3% (baseline 0.02%), p99 +220ms, queue_wait time increased.

ops-lee: Can someone drop the quick graf link? Curious if it's a batching or kv-cache issue.

alex: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/modelrouter-canary — p50 45ms, p95 180ms, p99 620ms, queue_wait spikes correlated with increased batch size on pool-a.

maria: Looks like request coalescing bumped batch sizes; pool-a has slower hosts right now which amplifies queue wait. If we promote, risk wider tail latency. I +1 to holding and routing-pin ap-east to v11.7.5.

jin: Agreed. Also propose toggling dynamic-batching to conservative on the canary while infra investigates to reduce batch queuing.

pm-kate: Quick customer comms question: we already published 12.0.0 release notes. Will pinning require a retraction?

maria: No retraction. Pinning is a routing override. We'll append a short note to release notes: "ap-east rollout paused due to elevated tail latency; investigating batching behavior."

ops-lee: Command I plan to run: ```
redwood routing override --svc modelrouter --region ap-east --target v11.7.5 --note "hold: queue_backpressure p99 spike"
```

alex: I approve the pin. Jin, please add the dynamic-batching toggle to the running canary config as a temporary mitigation.

jin: Will do. Patch to canary config: set DYNAMIC_BATCHING=conservative and set MAX_BATCH_DELAY_MS=10. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing override ticket #ROUTE-84021 created by ops-lee. Pending execution.

ops-lee: Executing routing override and config patch now. Will report status shortly.

(35s)

ops-lee: Done. ap-east pinned to v11.7.5; canary config updated with conservative batching in ap-east. Verified traffic shift to stable; p99 trending down within ~45s. :white_check_mark:

alex: Nice work. Leaving logical canary at 2% but drained in ap-east. HOLD on any percent bumps or cross-region promotion until infra confirms batch pool health.

maria: Adding diagnostics to ticket: capture batch size histograms, host latency distribution in pool-a, and kv-cache hit/miss rates. Assigning to infra/serving.

pm-kate: I'll append a short release-note addendum and notify customer success with a one-liner.

jin: If infra finds slow hosts in pool-a, plan is to cordon and replace; if it's software-level batching regression, we'll prepare a patch and target a limited hotfix roll.

ops-lee: Rollback thresholds proposed: sustained errors >=1.0% for 5m OR p99 >= 900ms for 10m -> escalate to immediate global rollback to v11.7.5 and cancel other canaries.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary status changed -> HOLD (2%) by ops-lee at 3524690219.

alex: ACK. Thanks all. We'll reconvene if rollback required. Reopen thread for cutover or rollback decisions.
